points.point: Does mcp.blotato.com expose an SSE (/sse) endpoint

verdict.reason: The customer asks whether mcp.blotato.com has an SSE endpoint or a fallback for SSE-only clients, and no candidate entry mentions SSE, /sse, or any transport fallback; the closest entry (claude-clients-support) only gives the https://mcp.blotato.com/mcp URL for Claude clients, which does not answer the SSE question.
